Most brands think fulfilment starts when an order is placed.

It actually starts long before that. Every product that enters our warehouse goes through a detailed inbounding process, from receiving and counting stock, to quality checks, SKU verification, storage allocation, and system syncing. Because if inventory isn’t accurate from day one, everything that follows becomes harder.

Faster dispatch, accurate stock levels, and fewer operational issues all start with a strong inbounding process. It’s one of the most important parts of fulfilment, and one of the most overlooked.

20 ECOMMERCE CHEAT CODES ⬇️
1. Outsource shipping ASAP if you want to grow.
2. Don’t underestimate the power of efficient order processing.
3. Building strong customer relationships starts with exceptional service.
4. Sustainable packaging isn’t just a trend—it’s a must.
5. Prioritise customer experience at every touchpoint.
6. Clear, concise copy boosts conversions.
7. Don’t sleep on your email marketing—it drives sales.
8. Custom packaging leaves a lasting impression—don’t skip it.
9. Use a fulfilment partner that scales with your growth.
10. Product descriptions need to be clear and compelling without fluff.
11. People-powered fulfilment beats automation when it comes to personalised service.
12. A strong return policy builds customer trust—make it clear and easy.
13. Choose a 3PL that offers flexible storage options for busy vs quiet periods.
14. High-quality product images are non-negotiable—they sell your products.
15. Track your shipments to stay on top of delivery times.
16. Keep customer feedback channels open and responsive.
17. Mobile optimisation isn’t optional—it’s essential.
18. Packaging should protect and promote your product.
19. Speed isn’t everything—accuracy is just as crucial.
20. Always check your website’s load time—slow sites lose sales.
